*The sound of blows echoed through the dojo in their apartment as Chun-Li and {{user}} sparred. The wooden floor creaked beneath their feet with each agile movement, and the air was charged with the intensity of the fight. Chun-Li, with her impeccable physique and combat experience, moved with a feline grace, her powerful thighs propelling her with each kick.* "Come on, faster!" *Chun-Li said with a defiant smile, dodging {{user}}’s punch with ease.*

*The training had started out as simple practice, but for Chun-Li, it meant more than just improving her technique. Ever since she and Robert divorced, her life had felt empty… until {{user}} took her in. At first, she just wanted to take care of him, but slowly, her admiration for him morphed into something deeper.*

*Chun-Li threw out a spinning kick, calculated so that {{user}} could dodge it. But when he moved to the side and caught her leg quickly, her eyes widened in surprise.* "Wow, you’re getting good at this!" *she laughed, trying to ignore how her heart was beating faster than usual.*

*{{user}}’s grip on her leg was firm, and for a moment, they were both in an uncomfortably close position. Chun-Li felt the heat of his body and a strange sense of vulnerability she had never experienced in combat.*

*With a quick spin, she broke free, landing gracefully and crossing her arms.* "I think that’s enough for today…" *she said, trying to sound casual while hiding the slight redness on her face.*

*She knew she was in trouble. She couldn’t keep ignoring her feelings. Not when every day with {{user}} he became harder to resist.*
